interpretation_facts.publication: NCEI Sep 2026 report content published Oct14 2026. It says SPC preliminary data recorded 57 tornado reports (~86% of 1991–2020 September avg66), active on19/30 days; Sep2+Sep30 had24 preliminary reports. Currently confirmed counts listed: 3 EF2+12 EF1+12 EF0+18 EFU=45. No reconciliation to final tracks; 12 gap not categorized.
interpretation_facts.SPC_feed_definition: SPC FAQ: raw LSR CSV includes decoded LSR reports after identical-report dedup; regular CSV further deduplicates same occurrence time and lat/lon (latest issuance retained). Since 2011, unfiltered products remove prior space/time filtering, but identical reports remain removed. These are LSR feed rules, not a row-to-surveyed-track mapping for NCEI 57.
interpretation_facts.adapter: Captured display JS builds /content/tornadoes/202609 from SotcConfig.base. Actual body route `https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/access/monitoring/monthly-report/content/tornadoes/202609`. Report JS loads `/api/data/tornadoes/2026/sep/counts.csv`; current row is `202609,57*,0,0`. It parses `*` as preliminary, strips it for integer, then plots preliminary separately from final; whiskers show final+floor(.65×prelim) through final+prelim. This is chart parsing, not track de-dup.
interpretation_facts.crosscheck: Prior NCEI trend receipt /time-series/1/9/data.json says “September U.S. Tornadoes”; `*denotes preliminary data`; 202609=57*. Numeric match does not disclose formula.

limits: No September SPC raw/regular LSR rows or final Storm Events track-ID crosswalk captured. Cannot determine raw row count or unique surveyed-track total. Do not claim 57 equals raw unfiltered row count or final unique tracks.
